Tourist information centres atTourist information centres at
airportsairports
*301. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI ANAND SHARMA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
set-up round-the-clock tourist information
centres at all the International Airports of
the country manned by competent and
qualified staff to provide information to the
tourists; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Leasing of aircrafts by AILeasing of aircrafts by AI
†*302. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India has
taken a decision to take aircrafts on lease;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the number of aircrafts which would
be taken on lease and the period thereof;
(d) how old are these aircrafts and the
amount that will have to be paid by Air
India for each aircraft every year; and
(e) the extent to which Air India’s
earnings will increase every year by taking
these aircrafts on lease?
Conference on Panchayati Raj andConference on Panchayati Raj and
Rural DevelopmentRural Development
†*303. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the details of the main
recommendations of the Conference of
Chief Ministers and Ministers of
Panchayati Raj and Rural Development
held recently in Delhi on Panchayati Raj
and Rural Development;
(b) whether any work plan to
implement the said recommendations has
been formulated; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

Self-employment schemesSelf-employment schemes
*304. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) what are the various self-
employment schemes being run for
extending credit to unemployed youth by
different banks in different States;
(b) whether these schemes conform to
the local resource availability and the
employment based on such resources;
(c) whether a periodic evaluation is done
to judge their efficacy for continuation; if
so, the resultant achievements in terms of
credit extended for self-employment; and
(d) the details of the credit schemes,
which were initiated but failed to take off
to promote sustainable employment and
the reasons for their failure?
Loans for SSILoans for SSI
*305. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total amount of loans sanctioned
by various nationalised banks for the setting
up of small scale industries in various States
during the last three years; and
(b) what guidelines have been prescribed
by Government for granting loans to SSI
units in the country?
LPG marketing by private companiesLPG marketing by private companies
*306. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Oil Corporation has
objected to allowing some private
companies to sell LPG directly to bulk
consumers on the plea that the situation
will have an adverse impact on State-run
marketing companies; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard?
Profit by oil companiesProfit by oil companies
*307. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) what is the amount of profit earned
by public sector oil companies during the
last three years;
(b) whether it is a fact that oil
companies, under the garb of increased
crude oil prices at international level, time
and again propose increase in prices of
petroleum products; and
(c) what were the selling prices per litre
of diesel and petrol as on 1st April from
1999 to 2004 in different parts of the
country?
Coal gassification project of GAILCoal gassification project of GAIL
*308. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether GAIL has been examining
coal gassification option for commercial
projects in eastern parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the source of technology and the countries,
where this technology is being used for
power generation and fertilizer production;
(c) whether Government will extend any
fiscal and other support for projects on
coal gassification in view of high oil price
scenario; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

Additional flights by IA and AI
1314. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Airlines and Air
India propose to introduce additional flights
on the existing routes; and
(b) if so, the details of proposal mooted
in that regard for 2004-05, particularly
direct flights from Delhi to all State Capitals
of the North-Eastern States?
Purchase of carpets by AI
1315. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India has
suffered a loss of more than Rs. 2 crore on
purchase of non-existent carpets from a
US company sometime back;
(b) whether it is also a fact that CVC
has indicted the present Commercial
Director and others involved in the purchase
of carpets for causing loss of revenue to
Air India; and
(c) if so, what are the details of CVC
report and the action taken by Government
against guilty officers?
GoM on restructuring of airports
1316. SHRI BALAWANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR:
SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Group of Ministers was
constituted for restructuring of Delhi and
Mumbai Airports;
(b) whether the Group has since
finalised the details of restructuring and
modernisation of these airports as per
international standards;
(c) if so, the details of the plan; and
(d) whether FDI upto 49 per cent only
is to be invited for modernisation and
restructuring as per the Government's
decision?

Touts at airports
1317. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI ANAND SHARMA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that touts and
criminals, in the garb of taxi drivers, are
operating with impunity at the
International Airports in the country,
particularly in the national capital with the
connivance of police and airport staff; and
(b) if  so, what action  has been taken
by Government to rid the airports of the
touts and other anti-social elements
operating at the airports, airport-wise?
Air service from Lohgoan Airport
†1318. SHRI BALAWANT  ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the civil flight from Pune
based Lohgoan Airport is proposed to be
discontinued;
(b) if so, since when;
(c) whether there is any plan to develop
new aerodrome near Chakan (at the Khed
Tehsil) Distt. Pune;
(d) if so, whether Government have
fixed any time-bound programme and
earmarked funds therefor; and
(e) whether it would be an international
airport?
Air services from Madhya Pradesh
†1319. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal is pending
with the Central Government to provide
air service from Madhya Pradesh to South
India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the present arrangement for air
services to link Madhya Pradesh with
South India?
 Missing of Passengers' luggage at
Palam Airport
†1320. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister  of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that incidents of
theft of luggage of passengers is
continuously taking place despite the
changes made in the security staff at the
Palam Airport;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the number of theft incidents that
took place during the last two years and till
date together with the details of loss to
each passenger, month-wise;
(d) the compensation provided by
Government to each of the affected
passengers; and
(e) the details of the steps  being taken
by Government to curb incidents of theft?

to state:
